newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Nov 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Nov 20.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Yemeni government and French firm Alcatel signed two contracts worth a total of $20 million to upgrade Yemen's telecommunications network, the official Saba news agency said.
- Work in al-Jubail Tourism and Investment Company will start next January with a capital of 100 million riyals, a member in the construction commission of the company said. REUTERS
